name: Agent Office
description: A virtual office dashboard that visualizes every agent's live status — who is busy, for how long, and what they just finished — with team-shared avatars and dispatch flight paths.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 智能体办公室看板。用拟物办公室的方式实时展示每个智能体的工作状态：谁在忙、忙了多久、刚完成了什么，以及智能体之间的派活协作（跨卡片连线与飞行轨迹）。头像存在后端，团队统一、跟人走。
description_i18n.en-US: A virtual office dashboard that visualizes every agent's live status — who is busy, for how long, and what they just finished — with team-shared avatars and dispatch flight paths.

author: Osier-Yi
